capabilities: : Display folder paths in tab titles
extras: Known limitations include delay in updating tab title, titles resetting after app restart, and only focused tabs being changed.
problem: Users lack a quick visual indicator of the note's file location (folder context) within the tab title.

relations.evidence: Template for Obsidian community plugins with build configuration and development best practices.

summary: A plugin that displays the current folder path within the title of the active tab in Obsidian.
